<style>
.chl-app-shell {
  background-color: #F8FAFC;

  max-width: 1560px;

  margin: 1rem auto 3rem auto;
  border-radius: 8px;

  box-shadow: 0 10px 25px rgba(0, 0, 0, 0.25);

}

  background-color: #00747A;

}

  color: #FFFFFF;

}

}

.chl-tab-btn.active,
.chl-tab-btn:hover {
  background-color: #FFFFFF;
  border-color: #FFFFFF;
  color: #00747A;
}

.chl-layout {
  display: grid;
  grid-template-columns: 320px minmax(0, 1fr);
  min-height: 780px;
}

@media (max-width: 992px) {
  .chl-layout {
    grid-template-columns: minmax(0, 1fr);
    min-height: auto;
  }
  .chl-sidebar {
    border-right: none !important;

  .chl-sidebar h4,

    grid-column: 1 / -1;

<div class="chl-app-shell">
  <div class="chl-subnav">

      <button id="btn-tab-board" class="chl-tab-btn active" onclick="switchChlTab('board')">Draft Board</button>
      <button id="btn-tab-dossier" class="chl-tab-btn" onclick="switchChlTab('dossier')">Prospect Dossier</button>

  <!-- TAB 1: LONGITUDINAL DRAFT BOARD -->
  <div id="panel-board" class="chl-layout">
    <div class="chl-sidebar">
      <h4>Draft Class Rankings</h4>
      <p>Comprehensive multi-pillar draft board, translated scoring trajectories, spatial residuals, and 7-year NHL eWAR projections. <em>Click any row to open that player's Prospect Dossier.</em></p>

      <div class="chl-field">

          <label><input type="radio" name="board_role" value="skater" onchange="updateDraftBoard()"> Skaters Only (F / D)</label>

          <option value="surplus_ewar">Value Picks (Highest Surplus Value)</option>
          <option value="risers_30d">Biggest Risers (30-Day Movement)</option>

          <option value="RW">Right Wings (RW)</option>

      <div class="chl-field">
        <label for="board_min_equity">Minimum Draft Equity (% of #1 Pick): <span id="lbl_min_eq">0.0</span></label>

          <div class="kpi-title">Total Ranked Pool</div>

        </div></div>

      <div class="chl-card">

        </div>

        </div>
      </div>

      <div class="charts-grid">

          <div class="chl-card-header">Longitudinal Trajectory vs. Expected Selection Slot</div>

        </div>
        <div class="chl-card">
          <div class="chl-card-header">Physical Stature Distribution (Height vs. Weight)</div>
          <div class="chl-card-body"><div id="board_stature_plot" style="width: 100%;"></div></div>

    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- TAB 2: PROSPECT DOSSIER -->
  <div id="panel-dossier" class="chl-layout" style="display: none;">
    <div class="chl-sidebar">
      <h4>Prospect Dossier</h4>
      <p>Comprehensive individual prospect evaluation, longitudinal scoring translations, 7-year NHL eWAR projections, and 5-year career pathways.</p>

      <div class="chl-field">
        <label>Talent Pool:</label>
        <div class="chl-radio-group">
          <label><input type="radio" name="dossier_role" value="skater" checked onchange="syncDossierPool()"> Skaters (Trajectory + eWAR)</label>

        <label for="dossier_cohort">Draft Class Year:</label>
        <select id="dossier_cohort" onchange="syncDossierPool()"></select>

        <label for="dossier_search">Search Prospect:</label>
        <input type="text" id="dossier_search" placeholder="Filter by name..." oninput="populateDossierSelect()" />
      </div>

        <label for="dossier_player">Select Prospect:</label>
        <select id="dossier_player" size="11" style="height: auto;" onchange="renderDossier()"></select>

      <h5>Share & Export Dossier</h5>
      <p>Download a high-resolution PNG card or copy a direct link to this prospect.</p>
      <button class="chl-btn chl-btn-primary" onclick="downloadSocialCardPng()" style="margin-bottom: 0.45rem;">Download Prospect Card (PNG)</button>
      <button id="btn_copy_link" class="chl-btn" onclick="copyProspectLink()" style="background-color:#334155;">Copy Direct Link to Prospect</button>
    </div>

    <div class="chl-main">
      <div class="chl-card">
        <div class="chl-card-header">Prospect Evaluation Dossier & 5-Year Developmental Pathway</div>
        <div class="chl-card-body" style="padding: 0.75rem;">
          <div id="dossier_svg_container" style="width: 100%; overflow-x: auto;"></div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div id="dossier_comps_card" class="chl-card" style="display: none;">
        <div class="chl-card-header" style="flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 0.35rem;">
          <span>Historical Draft-Age Comparables (2014–2024 Draft Classes)</span>
          <span style="font-size: 0.76rem; font-weight: 500; color: #64748B;">Click any comparable to inspect their Prospect Dossier</span>
        </div>
        <div class="chl-card-body" id="dossier_comps_container" style="padding: 0.85rem 1.05rem;"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>
</div>

<script>
let ALL_PROSPECTS = [];
let MAX_COHORT_YEAR = 2027;
let HIST_COMP_CACHE = null;
let CURRENT_BOARD_ROWS = [];
let CURRENT_DOSSIER_POOL = [];

function syncUrlState(tab) {
  try {
    const activeTab = tab || (document.getElementById('panel-dossier').style.display !== 'none' ? 'dossier' : 'board');
    const params = new URLSearchParams();
    params.set('tab', activeTab);
    if (activeTab === 'dossier') {
      params.set('year', document.getElementById('dossier_cohort').value || String(MAX_COHORT_YEAR));
      params.set('role', getRadioVal('dossier_role'));
      const pVal = document.getElementById('dossier_player').value;
      if (pVal) params.set('player', pVal);
    } else {
      params.set('year', document.getElementById('board_cohort').value || String(MAX_COHORT_YEAR));
      params.set('role', getRadioVal('board_role'));
    }
    const newUrl = `${window.location.pathname}?${params.toString()}`;
    window.history.replaceState({}, '', newUrl);
  } catch (e) {}
}

function copyProspectLink() {
  syncUrlState('dossier');
  const btn = document.getElementById('btn_copy_link');
  navigator.clipboard.writeText(window.location.href).then(() => {
    if (btn) {
      const orig = btn.textContent;
      btn.textContent = '✓ Direct Link Copied!';
      btn.style.backgroundColor = '#059669';
      setTimeout(() => { btn.textContent = orig; btn.style.backgroundColor = '#334155'; }, 2000);
    }
  });
}

function buildHistoricalCompPools() {
  if (HIST_COMP_CACHE || !ALL_PROSPECTS || ALL_PROSPECTS.length === 0) return;

  const skPool = ALL_PROSPECTS.filter(d =>
    d.role_type === 'skater' &&
    Number(d.draft_cohort_year) <= 2024 &&
    (Boolean(d.is_drafted) || Number(d.actual_nhl_gp || 0) >= 20) &&
    Number(d.expected_pick || 224) <= 210
  ).map(d => {
    const p0 = Number(d.shrunken_pace_d0 ?? d.trajectory_ppg ?? 0.4);
    const p1 = (Number(d.ppg_d1 || 0) > 0) ? Number(d.ppg_d1) : p0 * 0.65;
    return {
      row: d,
      pos: String(d.position_group || 'F'),
      re: Number(d.re_entry_level || 0) > 0 ? 1 : 0,
      st0: String(d.state_t0 || mapCircuitToTier(d.league)),
      vec: [
        Number(d.trajectory_ppg || 0.4),
        p0,
        p1,
        Number(d.growth_velocity || 0),
        Math.log(Math.max(Number(d.expected_pick || 100), 1)),
        Number(d.proj_7yr_ewar || 0),
        Number(d.height_inches || 72),
        Number(d.weight_lbs || 185)
      ]
    };
  });

  const gkPool = ALL_PROSPECTS.filter(d =>
    d.role_type === 'goalie' &&
    Number(d.draft_cohort_year) <= 2024 &&
    Boolean(d.is_drafted) &&
    (Number(d.actual_nhl_gp || 0) >= 10 || Number(d.actual_draft_pick || 225) <= 64 || Number(d.draft_cohort_year) >= 2021)
  ).map(d => {
    const g0 = Number(d.gsax_rate_d0 ?? d.trajectory_gsax_rate ?? 0);
    return {
      row: d,
      re: Number(d.re_entry_level || 0) > 0 ? 1 : 0,
      st0: String(d.state_t0 || mapCircuitToTier(d.league)),
      vec: [
        Number(d.trajectory_gsax_rate || 0),
        g0,
        Number(d.workload_weight || 0.5),
        Math.log(Math.max(Number(d.expected_pick || 90), 15)),
        Number(d.proj_7yr_ewar || 0),
        Number(d.height_inches || 74),
        Number(d.weight_lbs || 190)
      ]
    };
  });

  const calcSds = (pool, kLen) => {
    const sds = [];
    for (let j = 0; j < kLen; j++) {
      const vals = pool.map(x => x.vec[j]);
      const m = vals.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / Math.max(vals.length, 1);
      const v = vals.reduce((a, b) => a + (b - m) * (b - m), 0) / Math.max(vals.length - 1, 1);
      sds.push(Math.max(Math.sqrt(v), 1e-4));
    }
    return sds;
  };

  const skSds = calcSds(skPool, 8);
  const skW   = [2.6, 1.8, 1.2, 0.5, 2.8, 2.5, 1.1, 1.0];
  const skWSum= skW.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

  const gkSds = calcSds(gkPool, 7);
  const gkW   = [2.6, 2.0, 1.5, 2.8, 2.4, 2.5, 1.6];
  const gkWSum= gkW.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);

  // Precompute CSLS hubness baseline for goalies
  gkPool.forEach((c1, i) => {
    const dists = [];
    gkPool.forEach((c2, j) => {
      if (i === j) return;
      let s = 0;
      for (let f = 0; f < 7; f++) {
        const z = (c1.vec[f] - c2.vec[f]) / gkSds[f];
        s += gkW[f] * z * z;
      }
      dists.push(Math.sqrt(s / gkWSum));
    });
    dists.sort((a, b) => a - b);
    const kTop = dists.slice(0, Math.min(7, dists.length));
    c1.rHub = kTop.reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0) / Math.max(kTop.length, 1);
  });

  HIST_COMP_CACHE = { skPool, skSds, skW, skWSum, gkPool, gkSds, gkW, gkWSum };
}

function renderUpcomingProspectComps(p) {
  const cardEl = document.getElementById('dossier_comps_card');
  const contEl = document.getElementById('dossier_comps_container');
  if (!cardEl || !contEl) return;

  const isUpcoming = !Boolean(p.is_drafted) && Number(p.draft_cohort_year) >= MAX_COHORT_YEAR;
  if (!isUpcoming) {
    cardEl.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }

  buildHistoricalCompPools();
  if (!HIST_COMP_CACHE) {
    cardEl.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }

  const isGk = (p.role_type === 'goalie');
  const tRe  = Number(p.re_entry_level || 0) > 0 ? 1 : 0;
  const tSt0 = String(p.state_t0 || mapCircuitToTier(p.league));
  let scored = [];

  if (isGk) {
    const { gkPool, gkSds, gkW, gkWSum } = HIST_COMP_CACHE;
    const g0 = Number(p.gsax_rate_d0 ?? p.trajectory_gsax_rate ?? 0);
    const tVec = [
      Number(p.trajectory_gsax_rate || 0),
      g0,
      Number(p.workload_weight || 0.5),
      Math.log(Math.max(Number(p.expected_pick || 90), 15)),
      Number(p.proj_7yr_ewar || 0),
      Number(p.height_inches || 74),
      Number(p.weight_lbs || 190)
    ];
    const isEuroT = ["EURO_JUNIOR", "PRO_DEVELOP", "EURO_ELITE"].includes(tSt0);
    gkPool.forEach(c => {
      if (c.re !== tRe || c.row.clean_name === p.clean_name) return;
      let s = 0;
      for (let f = 0; f < 7; f++) {
        const z = (c.vec[f] - tVec[f]) / gkSds[f];
        s += gkW[f] * z * z;
      }
      const isEuroC = ["EURO_JUNIOR", "PRO_DEVELOP", "EURO_ELITE"].includes(c.st0);
      const regPen = (isEuroT === isEuroC) ? 0.0 : 0.25;
      const rawD = Math.sqrt(s / gkWSum + regPen * regPen);
      const cslsD = rawD - 0.30 * (c.rHub || 0);
      scored.push({ row: c.row, rawD, sortD: cslsD });
    });
  } else {
    const { skPool, skSds, skW, skWSum } = HIST_COMP_CACHE;
    const tPos = String(p.position_group || 'F');
    const p0 = Number(p.shrunken_pace_d0 ?? p.trajectory_ppg ?? 0.4);
    const p1 = (Number(p.ppg_d1 || 0) > 0) ? Number(p.ppg_d1) : p0 * 0.65;
    const tVec = [
      Number(p.trajectory_ppg || 0.4),
      p0,
      p1,
      Number(p.growth_velocity || 0),
      Math.log(Math.max(Number(p.expected_pick || 100), 1)),
      Number(p.proj_7yr_ewar || 0),
      Number(p.height_inches || 72),
      Number(p.weight_lbs || 185)
    ];
    skPool.forEach(c => {
      if (c.pos !== tPos || c.re !== tRe || c.row.clean_name === p.clean_name) return;
      let s = 0;
      for (let f = 0; f < 8; f++) {
        const z = (c.vec[f] - tVec[f]) / skSds[f];
        s += skW[f] * z * z;
      }
      const tierPen = (c.st0 === tSt0) ? 0.0 : 0.35;
      const rawD = Math.sqrt(s / skWSum + tierPen * tierPen);
      scored.push({ row: c.row, rawD, sortD: rawD });
    });
  }

  scored.sort((a, b) => a.sortD - b.sortD);
  const top4 = scored.slice(0, 4);
  if (top4.length === 0) {
    cardEl.style.display = 'none';
    return;
  }

  let html = `<div style="display: grid; grid-template-columns: repeat(auto-fit, minmax(240px, 1fr)); gap: 0.75rem;">`;
  top4.forEach((item, idx) => {
    const c = item.row;
    const matchPct = (100 * Math.exp(-0.42 * Math.max(item.rawD, 0.08))).toFixed(1);
    const cName = c.display_name || c.player_name;
    const cYr   = c.draft_cohort_year;
    const cPick = Number(c.actual_draft_pick || 0) > 0 ? `#${c.actual_draft_pick} Overall` : `Undrafted`;
    const cLg   = fmtLeague(c.league);
    const cHt   = fmtHeight(c.height_inches);
    const cWt   = c.weight_lbs >= 100 ? `${Math.round(c.weight_lbs)} lbs` : '';
    const cPace = isGk
      ? `${(Number(c.trajectory_gsax_rate || 0) * 100 >= 0 ? '+' : '')}${(Number(c.trajectory_gsax_rate || 0) * 100).toFixed(2)}% GSAx`
      : `${Number(c.trajectory_ppg || 0).toFixed(2)} OHL-Eq PPG`;
    const nhlGp = Number(c.actual_nhl_gp || 0);
    const nhlEw = Number(c.actual_7yr_ewar || 0);
    const nhlStr= nhlGp > 0
      ? `NHL Outcome: <b>${nhlGp} GP • ${nhlEw >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${nhlEw.toFixed(1)} eWAR</b>`
      : `NHL Outcome: Developing / Non-NHL`;
    const safeClean = String(c.clean_name || c.player_name).replace(/'/g, "\\'");

    html += `<div onclick="openProspectInDossier('${safeClean}', ${cYr}, '${c.role_type}')" style="background:#F8FAFC; border:1px solid #CBD5E1; border-left:4px solid #00747A; border-radius:6px; padding:0.65rem 0.8rem; cursor:pointer; transition:all 0.15s ease;" onmouseover="this.style.backgroundColor='#F1F5F9'" onmouseout="this.style.backgroundColor='#F8FAFC'">
      <div style="display:flex; justify-content:space-between; align-items:center; margin-bottom:0.25rem;">
        <div style="font-weight:800; font-size:0.95rem; color:#0F172A;">#${idx + 1} ${escXml(cName)}</div>
        <span style="background:#E0F2FE; color:#0369A1; border:1px solid #7DD3FC; font-weight:700; font-size:0.74rem; padding:1px 6px; border-radius:4px;">${matchPct}% Match</span>
      </div>
      <div style="font-size:0.80rem; color:#475569; font-weight:600; margin-bottom:0.2rem;">${cYr} Draft (${cPick}) • ${escXml(cLg)}</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.78rem; color:#64748B; margin-bottom:0.25rem;">Draft-Age: <b>${cPace}</b> • ${cHt}${cWt ? ' | ' + cWt : ''}</div>
      <div style="font-size:0.78rem; color:#059669;">${nhlStr}</div>
    </div>`;
  });
  html += `</div>`;
  contEl.innerHTML = html;
  cardEl.style.display = 'block';
}

const TIER_ORDER = [
  "U18_PREP", "EURO_JUNIOR", "JUNIOR_A", "USHL_NTDP", "CHL",
  "NCAA", "PRO_DEVELOP", "EURO_ELITE", "ECHL", "AHL", "NHL"
];

const TIER_LABELS = {
  "U18_PREP":    "Prep / HS",
  "EURO_JUNIOR": "Euro U20",
  "JUNIOR_A":    "Junior A",
  "USHL_NTDP":   "USHL / NTDP",
  "CHL":         "Major Jr (CHL)",
  "NCAA":        "NCAA D1",
  "PRO_DEVELOP": "Euro Pro (Tier 2)",
  "EURO_ELITE":  "Euro Pro (Tier 1)",
  "ECHL":        "ECHL",
  "AHL":         "AHL",
  "NHL":         "NHL"
};

const TIER_COLORS = {
  "U18_PREP":    "#94A3B8",
  "EURO_JUNIOR": "#64748B",
  "JUNIOR_A":    "#0D9488",
  "USHL_NTDP":   "#2563EB",
  "CHL":         "#00747A",
  "NCAA":        "#8B5CF6",
  "PRO_DEVELOP": "#0EA5E9",
  "EURO_ELITE":  "#0284C7",
  "ECHL":        "#1E3A8A",
  "AHL":         "#D97706",
  "NHL":         "#059669"
};

const LEAGUE_DISPLAY_MAP = {
  "OHL": "OHL", "WHL": "WHL", "LHJMQ": "QMJHL", "USHL": "USHL", "USNTDP": "US NTDP",
  "NCAA": "NCAA", "BCHL": "BCHL", "AJHL": "AJHL", "MJHL": "MJHL", "SJHL": "SJHL",
  "OJHL": "OJHL", "CCHL": "CCHL", "THEMHL": "Maritime Jr A", "NAHL": "NAHL",
  "KHL": "KHL", "SHL": "SHL", "LIIGA": "Liiga", "NL": "Swiss NL", "ELH": "Czech Extraliga", "DEL": "DEL",
  "VHL": "VHL", "HA": "Allsvenskan", "MESTIS": "Mestis", "MAXA": "Czech Maxa", "ETTAN": "HockeyEttan", "SLOVAKIA": "Slovak Extraliga",
  "MHL": "MHL", "J20": "Sweden J20", "J18": "Sweden J18", "U20_SM": "Finland U20", "U18_SM": "Finland U18",
  "U20_ELIT": "Swiss U20", "U17_ELIT": "Swiss U17", "KB_ELJ": "Czech U20", "CZE_U17": "Czech U17",
  "SVK_U20": "Slovak U20", "USHS_PREP": "US Prep", "MN_AA": "MN High School", "MN_A": "MN High School",
  "CSSHL": "CSSHL Prep", "YOUTH_AAA": "AAA Youth", "AHL": "AHL", "ECHL": "ECHL", "NHL": "NHL"
};

const NODE_LEAGUE_MAP = {
  "OHL": "OHL", "WHL": "WHL", "LHJMQ": "QMJHL", "USHL": "USHL", "USNTDP": "NTDP",
  "NCAA": "NCAA", "BCHL": "BCHL", "AJHL": "AJHL", "MJHL": "MJHL", "SJHL": "SJHL",
  "OJHL": "OJHL", "CCHL": "CCHL", "THEMHL": "JrA", "NAHL": "NAHL",
  "KHL": "KHL", "SHL": "SHL", "LIIGA": "Liiga", "NL": "NL", "ELH": "ELH", "DEL": "DEL",
  "VHL": "VHL", "HA": "Allsv", "MESTIS": "Mestis", "MAXA": "Maxa", "ETTAN": "Ettan", "SLOVAKIA": "SVK",
  "MHL": "MHL", "J20": "J20", "J18": "J18", "U20_SM": "FIN20", "U18_SM": "FIN18",
  "U20_ELIT": "SUI20", "U17_ELIT": "SUI17", "KB_ELJ": "CZE20", "CZE_U17": "CZE17",
  "SVK_U20": "SVK20", "USHS_PREP": "Prep", "MN_AA": "MN HS", "MN_A": "MN HS",
  "CSSHL": "CSSHL", "YOUTH_AAA": "AAA", "AHL": "AHL", "ECHL": "ECHL", "NHL": "NHL"
};

function fmtLeague(code) {
  const k = String(code || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  return LEAGUE_DISPLAY_MAP[k] || k;
}

function fmtNodeLeague(code) {
  const k = String(code || "").trim().toUpperCase();
  return NODE_LEAGUE_MAP[k] || (k.length > 6 ? k.slice(0, 5) : k);
}

function fmtLeagueBanner(allLgs, primaryLg) {
  const rawParts = String(allLgs || primaryLg || "").split("/").map(s => s.trim()).filter(Boolean);
  let filtered = rawParts.length > 1 ? rawParts.filter(x => x !== "YOUTH_AAA" && x !== "U17_ELIT" && x !== "U18_SM" && x !== "CZE_U17" && x !== "J18") : rawParts;
  if (filtered.length === 0) filtered = rawParts;
  const mapped = [];
  filtered.forEach(c => {
    const lbl = fmtLeague(c);
    if (!mapped.includes(lbl)) mapped.push(lbl);
  });
  return mapped.slice(0, 3).join(" / ");
}

function mapCircuitToTier(lg) {
  const s = String(lg || "CHL").toUpperCase();
  if (s === "NHL") return "NHL";
  if (s === "AHL") return "AHL";
  if (s === "ECHL") return "ECHL";
  if (["KHL", "SHL", "LIIGA", "NL", "ELH", "DEL"].includes(s)) return "EURO_ELITE";
  if (["VHL", "HA", "MESTIS", "MAXA", "ETTAN", "SLOVAKIA"].includes(s)) return "PRO_DEVELOP";
  if (s === "NCAA") return "NCAA";
  if (["OHL", "WHL", "LHJMQ"].includes(s)) return "CHL";
  if (["USHL", "USNTDP"].includes(s)) return "USHL_NTDP";
  if (["BCHL", "AJHL", "MJHL", "SJHL", "OJHL", "CCHL", "THEMHL", "NAHL"].includes(s)) return "JUNIOR_A";
  if (["J20", "U20_SM", "U20_ELIT", "KB_ELJ", "SVK_U20", "MHL"].includes(s)) return "EURO_JUNIOR";
  return "U18_PREP";
}

function resolveGoaliePathwayProbs(s0, expPick, reEntry) {
  const pSlot  = Math.min(Math.max(Number(expPick || 90.0), 15.0), 224.0);
  const eliteW = Math.exp(-(pSlot - 20.0) / 65.0);
  const reLvl  = parseInt(reEntry || 0, 10) || 0;

  const zeroMap = () => {
    const m = {};
    TIER_ORDER.forEach(k => m[k] = 0.0);
    return m;
  };
  let p1 = zeroMap(), p2 = zeroMap(), p3 = zeroMap(), p4 = zeroMap();

  if (s0 === "USHL_NTDP") {
    p1["NCAA"] = 76 + 8 * eliteW; p1["USHL_NTDP"] = 18 - 6 * eliteW; p1["CHL"] = 6 - 2 * eliteW;
    p2["NCAA"] = 82 - 6 * eliteW; p2["AHL"] = 10 + 6 * eliteW; p2["ECHL"] = 5; p2["NHL"] = 3 * eliteW;
    p3["NCAA"] = 52 - 14 * eliteW; p3["AHL"] = 28 + 8 * eliteW; p3["ECHL"] = 12; p3["NHL"] = 8 + 6 * eliteW;
    p4["AHL"]  = 48 + 4 * eliteW; p4["NCAA"] = 20 - 8 * eliteW; p4["ECHL"] = 16 - 4 * eliteW; p4["NHL"] = 16 + 8 * eliteW;
  } else if (s0 === "CHL") {
    p1["CHL"] = 84 - 10 * eliteW; p1["NCAA"] = 14 + 8 * eliteW; p1["NHL"] = 2 * eliteW;
    p2["CHL"] = 62 - 14 * eliteW; p2["NCAA"] = 22 + 6 * eliteW; p2["AHL"] = 11 + 5 * eliteW; p2["ECHL"] = 3; p2["NHL"] = 2 + 3 * eliteW;
    p3["AHL"] = 52 + 10 * eliteW; p3["ECHL"] = 24 - 8 * eliteW; p3["NCAA"] = 16 - 4 * eliteW; p3["NHL"] = 8 + 12 * eliteW;
    p4["AHL"] = 54 + 4 * eliteW; p4["ECHL"] = 22 - 8 * eliteW; p4["NCAA"] = 8 - 4 * eliteW; p4["NHL"] = 16 + 8 * eliteW;
  } else if (s0 === "NCAA") {
    p1["NCAA"] = 86 - 10 * eliteW; p1["AHL"] = 10 + 6 * eliteW; p1["ECHL"] = 2; p1["NHL"] = 2 + 4 * eliteW;
    p2["NCAA"] = 58 - 16 * eliteW; p2["AHL"] = 28 + 10 * eliteW; p2["ECHL"] = 8; p2["NHL"] = 6 + 6 * eliteW;
    p3["AHL"] = 54 + 4 * eliteW; p3["NCAA"] = 20 - 8 * eliteW; p3["ECHL"] = 14 - 4 * eliteW; p3["NHL"] = 12 + 8 * eliteW;
    p4["AHL"] = 52; p4["ECHL"] = 18 - 6 * eliteW; p4["NCAA"] = 8 - 4 * eliteW; p4["NHL"] = 22 + 10 * eliteW;
  } else if (s0 === "JUNIOR_A" || s0 === "U18_PREP") {
    p1["NCAA"] = 54 + 12 * eliteW; p1["USHL_NTDP"] = 24; p1["JUNIOR_A"] = 16 - 8 * eliteW; p1["CHL"] = 6;
    p2["NCAA"] = 78 + 6 * eliteW; p2["AHL"] = 8; p2["ECHL"] = 6; p2["USHL_NTDP"] = 8 - 6 * eliteW;
    p3["NCAA"] = 64 - 10 * eliteW; p3["AHL"] = 20 + 8 * eliteW; p3["ECHL"] = 12; p3["NHL"] = 4 + 2 * eliteW;
    p4["AHL"]  = 42 + 8 * eliteW; p4["NCAA"] = 30 - 8 * eliteW; p4["ECHL"] = 18; p4["NHL"] = 10;
  } else {
    p1["EURO_ELITE"] = 38 + 16 * eliteW; p1["PRO_DEVELOP"] = 36 - 6 * eliteW; p1["EURO_JUNIOR"] = 20 - 10 * eliteW; p1["AHL"] = 6;
    p2["EURO_ELITE"] = 44 + 8 * eliteW; p2["PRO_DEVELOP"] = 24 - 8 * eliteW; p2["AHL"] = 22 + 4 * eliteW; p2["ECHL"] = 5; p2["NHL"] = 5 + 4 * eliteW;
    p3["AHL"] = 42 + 6 * eliteW; p3["EURO_ELITE"] = 30 - 8 * eliteW; p3["PRO_DEVELOP"] = 10 - 4 * eliteW; p3["ECHL"] = 6; p3["NHL"] = 12 + 10 * eliteW;
    p4["AHL"] = 46; p4["EURO_ELITE"] = 24 - 6 * eliteW; p4["ECHL"] = 8; p4["NHL"] = 22 + 6 * eliteW;
  }

  return (reLvl >= 1) ? { p_t1: p2, p_t2: p3, p_t3: p4 } : { p_t1: p1, p_t2: p2, p_t3: p3 };
}

function normCard100(vMap, minCut = 2.0) {
  let entries = Object.entries(vMap).filter(([_, v]) => v >= minCut);
  if (entries.length === 0) {
    let maxK = TIER_ORDER[0], maxV = -1;
    Object.entries(vMap).forEach(([k, v]) => { if (v > maxV) { maxV = v; maxK = k; } });
    entries = [[maxK, Math.max(maxV, 1)]];
  }
  const sum = entries.reduce((acc, [_, v]) => acc + v, 0) || 1;
  let scaled = {};
  let totalScaled = 0;
  let maxKey = entries[0][0], maxVal = -1;
  entries.forEach(([k, v]) => {
    const r = Math.round((v / sum) * 100);
    scaled[k] = r;
    totalScaled += r;
    if (r > maxVal) { maxVal = r; maxKey = k; }
  });
  const diff = 100 - totalScaled;
  if (diff !== 0 && maxKey) scaled[maxKey] += diff;
  return scaled;
}

function fmtHeight(inches) {
  const h = parseInt(inches, 10);
  if (isNaN(h) || h < 48) return "-";
  return `${Math.floor(h / 12)}'${h % 12}"`;
}

function escXml(str) {
  return String(str ?? '')
    .replace(/&/g, '&amp;')
    .replace(/</g, '&lt;')
    .replace(/>/g, '&gt;')
    .replace(/"/g, '&quot;');
}

function getRadioVal(name) {
  const el = document.querySelector(`input[name="${name}"]:checked`);
  return el ? el.value : "skater";
}

function showSvgTip(evt, html) {
  const tip = document.getElementById('chl_svg_tooltip');
  tip.innerHTML = html;
  tip.style.display = 'block';
  tip.style.left = (evt.clientX + 14) + 'px';
  tip.style.top  = (evt.clientY - 18) + 'px';
}

function hideSvgTip() {
  const tip = document.getElementById('chl_svg_tooltip');
  if (tip) tip.style.display = 'none';
}

function switchChlTab(tab) {
  hideSvgTip();
  document.getElementById('panel-board').style.display   = (tab === 'board')   ? 'grid' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('panel-dossier').style.display = (tab === 'dossier') ? 'grid' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('btn-tab-board').classList.toggle('active', tab === 'board');
  document.getElementById('btn-tab-dossier').classList.toggle('active', tab === 'dossier');
  if (tab === 'dossier') {
    if (CURRENT_DOSSIER_POOL.length === 0) syncDossierPool();
    else renderDossier();
  } else {
    updateDraftBoard();
  }
}

function openProspectInDossier(cleanName, cohortYear, role) {
  document.querySelector(`input[name="dossier_role"][value="${role}"]`).checked = true;
  document.getElementById('dossier_cohort').value = String(cohortYear);
  document.getElementById('dossier_search').value = '';
  syncDossierPool(cleanName);
  switchChlTab('dossier');
}

function tipHdr(label, tip) {
  return `<span class="th-tip" data-tip="${tip}" title="${tip}">${label}</span>`;
}

// ============================================================================
// TAB 1: LONGITUDINAL DRAFT BOARD
// ============================================================================
function updateDraftBoard() {
  if (!ALL_PROSPECTS || ALL_PROSPECTS.length === 0) return;

  const role      = getRadioVal('board_role');
  const sortMode  = document.getElementById('board_sort_mode').value || 'market_pick';
  const cohortYr  = parseInt(document.getElementById('board_cohort').value, 10) || 2027;
  const league    = document.getElementById('board_league').value || 'ALL';
  const posFilter = document.getElementById('board_pos').value || 'ALL';
  const minEq     = parseFloat(document.getElementById('board_min_equity').value) || 0;
  const maxRows   = parseInt(document.getElementById('board_max_rows').value, 10) || 100;

  document.getElementById('wrap-sort-mode').style.display  = (role !== 'goalie') ? 'block' : 'none';
  document.getElementById('wrap-pos-filter').style.display = (role === 'skater') ? 'block' : 'none';

  let df = ALL_PROSPECTS.filter(d => (role === 'all' || d.role_type === role) && Number(d.draft_cohort_year) === cohortYr);

  if (league !== 'ALL') {
    df = df.filter(d => d.league === league);
  }

  if (role === 'skater' && posFilter !== 'ALL') {
    if (posFilter === 'F' || posFilter === 'D') {
      df = df.filter(d => d.position_group === posFilter);
    } else {
      df = df.filter(d => d.position_granular === posFilter);
    }
  }

  if (minEq > 0) {
    df = df.filter(d => (Number(d.draft_equity_score) || 0) >= minEq);
  }

  if (role !== 'goalie') {
    if (sortMode === 'ewar_bpa') {
      df.sort((a, b) => (Number(b.proj_7yr_ewar) || 0) - (Number(a.proj_7yr_ewar) || 0) || (Number(a.expected_pick) || 999) - (Number(b.expected_pick) || 999));
    } else if (sortMode === 'surplus_ewar') {
      df.sort((a, b) => (Number(b.surplus_7yr_ewar) || 0) - (Number(a.surplus_7yr_ewar) || 0) || (Number(b.proj_7yr_ewar) || 0) - (Number(a.proj_7yr_ewar) || 0));
    } else if (sortMode === 'risers_30d') {
      df.sort((a, b) => (Number(b.pick_delta) || 0) - (Number(a.pick_delta) || 0) || (Number(a.expected_pick) || 999) - (Number(b.expected_pick) || 999));
    } else {
      df.sort((a, b) => (Number(a.expected_pick) || 999) - (Number(b.expected_pick) || 999) || (Number(b.draft_equity_score) || 0) - (Number(a.draft_equity_score) || 0));
    }
  } else {
    df.sort((a, b) => (Number(a.expected_pick) || 999) - (Number(b.expected_pick) || 999) || (Number(b.draft_equity_score) || 0) - (Number(a.draft_equity_score) || 0));
  }
  syncUrlState('board');

  CURRENT_BOARD_ROWS = df;

  const roleTitle = (role === 'all') ? 'Combined (Skaters + Goalies)' : (role === 'skater' ? 'Skater' : 'Goaltender');
  document.getElementById('board_table_title').textContent = `Class of ${cohortYr} ${roleTitle} Master Draft Board`;
  if (df.length > 0) {
    document.getElementById('kpi_top_name').textContent = df[0].display_name || df[0].player_name;
    document.getElementById('kpi_top_sub').textContent  = `${fmtLeague(df[0].league)} • Projected Pick #${Math.round(Number(df[0].expected_pick || 1))}`;
    if (df.length > 1) {
      document.getElementById('kpi_lead_name').textContent = df[1].display_name || df[1].player_name;
      document.getElementById('kpi_lead_sub').textContent  = `${fmtLeague(df[1].league)} • Equity: ${Number(df[1].draft_equity_score || 0).toFixed(1)}`;
    } else {
      document.getElementById('kpi_lead_name').textContent = 'N/A';
      document.getElementById('kpi_lead_sub').textContent  = '';
    }
    document.getElementById('kpi_pool_count').textContent = df.length.toLocaleString();
    const cutIdx = Math.min(31, df.length - 1);
    document.getElementById('kpi_r1_cutoff').textContent = `${Number(df[cutIdx].draft_equity_score || 0).toFixed(1)} Equity`;
  } else {
    document.getElementById('kpi_top_name').textContent  = 'N/A';
    document.getElementById('kpi_top_sub').textContent   = '';
    document.getElementById('kpi_lead_name').textContent = 'N/A';
    document.getElementById('kpi_lead_sub').textContent  = '';
    document.getElementById('kpi_pool_count').textContent= '0';
    document.getElementById('kpi_r1_cutoff').textContent = 'N/A';
  }

  renderBoardTable(df.slice(0, maxRows), role, cohortYr);
  renderBoardPlots(df.slice(0, Math.min(df.length, 400)), role === 'goalie' ? 'goalie' : 'skater');
}

function formatRoleBadge(rRaw) {
  const txt = String(rRaw || 'Organizational Depth').replace(/^Tier [0-9]: /, '');
  let style = 'color:#475569; background-color:#F1F5F9; border:1px solid #CBD5E1;';
  if (/^Tier 1/.test(rRaw)) style = 'color:#065F46; background-color:#D1FAE5; border:1px solid #6EE7B7;';
  else if (/^Tier 2/.test(rRaw)) style = 'color:#075985; background-color:#E0F2FE; border:1px solid #7DD3FC;';
  else if (/^Tier 3/.test(rRaw)) style = 'color:#1E40AF; background-color:#DBEAFE; border:1px solid #93C5FD;';
  else if (/^Tier 4/.test(rRaw)) style = 'color:#3730A3; background-color:#E0E7FF; border:1px solid #A5B4FC;';
  return `<span class="badge" style="${style} font-weight:700; padding:3px 6px; border-radius:4px;">${txt}</span>`;
}

function renderBoardTable(rows, role, cohortYr) {
  const container = document.getElementById('board_table_container');
  if (rows.length === 0) {
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:1.5rem; color:#64748B;">No prospects found matching filter criteria.</div>`;
    return;
  }

  const tblOpen  = '<' + 'table><' + 'thead><' + 'tr>';
  const tblClose = '</' + 'tbody></' + 'table>';
  let html = tblOpen;

  if (role === 'skater' || role === 'all') {
    html += `
      <th>${tipHdr("Rank", "Overall class rank in current view.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Prospect", "Prospect full name. Click any row to open their Prospect Dossier.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Pos", "Primary position (F, D, or G).")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("League", "Primary draft-year league (hover to view all circuits played).")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Size", "Verified height and weight in lbs.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("D-1 (GP)", "Prior season OHL-translated PPG (skaters) or GSAx % (goalies) and games played.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("D-0 (GP)", "Draft-season OHL-translated PPG (skaters) or GSAx % (goalies) and games played.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Adj. Pace (YoY)", "Kalman-shrunken longitudinal pace (Adj PPG for skaters, GSAx % for goalies) and YoY change.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("P(Draft)", "Ensemble probability of being selected in the 7-round NHL Entry Draft.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Proj. Pick", "Unified 1-to-1 NHL Entry Draft selection slot and round.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Actual", "Official NHL Entry Draft selection number (if drafted).")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Equity", "Unconditional draft capital score (0-100 scale).")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("NHL Prob", "Probability of reaching the NHL (with full-time regular / tandem starter probability in parentheses) during the 7-season team-control window.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("NHL Pace", "Projected 84-game scoring pace (skaters) or 50-game GSAx pace (goalies) as an NHL regular.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("7-Year eWAR", "Projected total Expected Wins Above Replacement accrued across the player's first 7 NHL seasons (pre-UFA team-control window).")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Projected Role", "Projected NHL lineup tier over the 7-season team-control window.")}</th>
    </tr></thead><tbody>`;

    rows.forEach((d, idx) => {
      const isRowGk = (d.role_type === 'goalie');
      const ht = fmtHeight(d.height_inches);
      const wt = d.weight_lbs >= 100 ? `${Math.round(d.weight_lbs)}` : '';
      const stature = (ht !== '-' && wt) ? `${ht} • ${wt}` : (ht !== '-' ? ht : (wt ? `${wt} lbs` : '-'));
      const actPick = (d.actual_draft_pick > 0) ? `<span class="badge" style="background-color:#0284C7;color:#FFFFFF;font-weight:700;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;">#${d.actual_draft_pick}</span>` : `<span style="color:#94A3B8;">-</span>`;
      const surp = Number(d.surplus_7yr_ewar || 0);
      const surpCol = surp >= 0 ? '#059669' : '#D6604D';
      const safeClean = String(d.clean_name || d.player_name).replace(/'/g, "\\'");
      const reBadge = (Number(d.re_entry_level) > 0)
        ? ` <span class="badge" style="background-color:#FEF3C7;color:#92400E;border:1px solid #F59E0B;font-size:0.70rem;font-weight:700;padding:1px 5px;border-radius:4px;" title="Overage Re-Entry (D+${d.re_entry_level})">D+${d.re_entry_level}</span>`
        : '';
      const pkInt = Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(d.expected_pick || 224)));
      const rndInt = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((pkInt - 0.5) / 32));
      const pDelta = parseInt(d.pick_delta || 0, 10);
      const deltaBadge = (pDelta >= 1)
        ? ` <span style="color:#059669;font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:700;" title="Moved up ${pDelta} spots over trailing 30 days">▲${pDelta}</span>`
        : (pDelta <= -1 ? ` <span style="color:#D6604D;font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:700;" title="Moved down ${Math.abs(pDelta)} spots over trailing 30 days">▼${Math.abs(pDelta)}</span>` : '');

      let posBadge, d1, d0, adjPace, nhlPace;
      if (isRowGk) {
        posBadge = `<span class="badge" style="background-color:#059669;color:#FFFFFF;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;">G</span>`;
        d1 = (d.gp_d1 > 0) ? `${(Number(d.gsax_rate_d1 || 0) * 100 >= 0 ? '+' : '')}${(Number(d.gsax_rate_d1 || 0) * 100).toFixed(2)}% <span style="color:#64748B;font-size:0.76rem;">(${d.gp_d1})</span>` : `<span style="color:#94A3B8;">-</span>`;
        const d0Rate = (d.gsax_rate_d0 !== null && d.gsax_rate_d0 !== undefined) ? Number(d.gsax_rate_d0) : Number(d.trajectory_gsax_rate || 0);
        d0 = (d.gp_d0 > 0) ? `${d0Rate * 100 >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${(d0Rate * 100).toFixed(2)}% <span style="color:#64748B;font-size:0.76rem;">(${d.gp_d0})</span>` : `<span style="color:#94A3B8;">-</span>`;
        const adjRate = Number(d.trajectory_gsax_rate || 0) * 100;
        adjPace = `<b>${adjRate >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${adjRate.toFixed(2)}%</b> <span style="color:#059669;font-size:0.72rem;font-weight:600;">GSAx</span>`;
        const gsax50 = Number(d.cond_nhl_gsax_50 || 0);
        nhlPace = `${gsax50 >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${gsax50.toFixed(1)} GSAx`;
      } else {
        posBadge = `<span class="badge bg-secondary" style="padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;">${d.position_granular || 'F'}</span>`;
        d1 = (d.gp_d1 > 0) ? `${Number(d.ppg_d1 || 0).toFixed(2)} <span style="color:#64748B;font-size:0.76rem;">(${d.gp_d1})</span>` : `<span style="color:#94A3B8;">-</span>`;
        d0 = (d.gp_d0 > 0) ? `${Number(d.ppg_d0 || 0).toFixed(2)} <span style="color:#64748B;font-size:0.76rem;">(${d.gp_d0})</span>` : `<span style="color:#94A3B8;">-</span>`;
        const velPct = Math.round((Number(d.growth_velocity) || 0) * 100);
        const velCol = velPct >= 0 ? '#059669' : '#D6604D';
        adjPace = `<b>${Number(d.trajectory_ppg || 0).toFixed(3)}</b> <span style="color:${velCol};font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600;">(${velPct >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${velPct}%)</span>`;
        nhlPace = `${Number(d.cond_nhl_pts_82 || 0).toFixed(1)} PTS`;
      }

      html += `<tr onclick="openProspectInDossier('${safeClean}', ${cohortYr}, '${d.role_type}')">
        <td>${idx + 1}</td>
        <td><b>${d.display_name || d.player_name}</b>${reBadge}</td>
        <td>${posBadge}</td>
        <td><b title="All Circuits: ${fmtLeagueBanner(d.all_leagues, d.league)}">${fmtLeague(d.league)}</b></td>
        <td>${stature}</td>
        <td>${d1}</td>
        <td>${d0}</td>
        <td>${adjPace}</td>
        <td>${Number(d.p_drafted || 0).toFixed(1)}%</td>
        <td><b>#${pkInt}</b>${deltaBadge} <span style="color:#64748B;font-size:0.76rem;">(Rd ${rndInt})</span></td>
        <td>${actPick}</td>
        <td><b><span style="color:#0284C7;">${Number(d.draft_equity_score || 0).toFixed(1)}</span></b></td>
        <td><b>${Number(d.p_nhl_20gp || 0).toFixed(1)}%</b> <span style="color:#64748B;font-size:0.75rem;">(${Math.round(d.p_nhl_100gp || 0)}%)</span></td>
        <td>${nhlPace}</td>
        <td><b><span style="color:#059669;">${Number(d.proj_7yr_ewar || 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${Number(d.proj_7yr_ewar || 0).toFixed(1)}</span></b> <span style="color:${surpCol};font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600;">(${surp >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${surp.toFixed(1)})</span></td>
        <td>${formatRoleBadge(d.nhl_projection_tier)}</td>
      </tr>`;
    });
  } else {
    html += `
      <th>${tipHdr("Rank", "Overall goaltender rank ordered by unconditional Draft Equity Score.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Netminder", "Goaltender full name. Click any row to open their Prospect Dossier.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("League", "Primary draft-year league.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Size", "Verified height and weight in lbs.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Eligibility", "First-time draft eligible (D0) or D+1/D+2 re-entry candidate.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("D-1 GSAx % (GP)", "Prior season Goals Saved Above Expected as a percentage of shots against.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("D-0 GSAx % (GP)", "Draft-season Goals Saved Above Expected as a percentage of shots against.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Adj. GSAx % (YoY)", "Kalman-shrunken longitudinal GSAx percentage and YoY change.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("D-0 Volume", "Total draft-season shots against (SA).")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("P(Draft)", "Ensemble probability of being selected in the NHL Entry Draft.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Proj. Pick", "Expected NHL Entry Draft selection slot and round.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Actual", "Official NHL Entry Draft selection number.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Equity", "Unconditional draft capital score (0-100 scale).")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("NHL Prob", "Probability of playing 10+ NHL games (with 50+ game tandem/starter probability in parentheses) during the 7-season team-control window.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("7-Year eWAR", "Projected Expected Wins Above Replacement across the goaltender's first 7 NHL seasons.")}</th>
      <th>${tipHdr("Projected Role", "Projected career NHL netminder role.")}</th>
    </tr></thead><tbody>`;

    rows.forEach((d, idx) => {
      const ht = fmtHeight(d.height_inches);
      const wt = d.weight_lbs >= 100 ? `${Math.round(d.weight_lbs)}` : '';
      const stature = (ht !== '-' && wt) ? `${ht} • ${wt}` : (ht !== '-' ? ht : (wt ? `${wt} lbs` : '-'));
      const elig = (d.re_entry_level > 0) ? `D+${d.re_entry_level} Re-Entry` : 'First-Time';
      const d1 = (d.gp_d1 > 0) ? `${(Number(d.gsax_rate_d1 || 0) * 100 >= 0 ? '+' : '')}${(Number(d.gsax_rate_d1 || 0) * 100).toFixed(2)}% <span style="color:#64748B;font-size:0.76rem;">(${d.gp_d1})</span>` : `<span style="color:#94A3B8;">-</span>`;
      const d0Rate = (d.gsax_rate_d0 !== null && d.gsax_rate_d0 !== undefined) ? Number(d.gsax_rate_d0) : Number(d.trajectory_gsax_rate || 0);
      const d0 = `${d0Rate * 100 >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${(d0Rate * 100).toFixed(2)}% <span style="color:#64748B;font-size:0.76rem;">(${d.gp_d0 || 0})</span>`;
      const adjRate = Number(d.trajectory_gsax_rate || 0) * 100;
      const gkDiff  = (d0Rate - Number(d.gsax_rate_d1 || 0)) * 100;
      const gkCol   = gkDiff >= 0 ? '#059669' : '#D6604D';
      const adjStr  = (d.gp_d1 > 0)
        ? `<b>${adjRate >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${adjRate.toFixed(2)}%</b> <span style="color:${gkCol};font-size:0.75rem;font-weight:600;">(${gkDiff >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${gkDiff.toFixed(2)}%)</span>`
        : `<b>${adjRate >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${adjRate.toFixed(2)}%</b>`;
      const actPick = (d.actual_draft_pick > 0) ? `<span class="badge" style="background-color:#0284C7;color:#FFFFFF;font-weight:700;padding:2px 6px;border-radius:4px;">#${d.actual_draft_pick}</span>` : `<span style="color:#94A3B8;">-</span>`;
      const safeClean = String(d.clean_name || d.player_name).replace(/'/g, "\\'");
      const pkInt = Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(d.expected_pick || 224)));
      const rndInt = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((pkInt - 0.5) / 32));
      const gkEwar = Number(d.proj_7yr_ewar || 0);

      html += `<tr onclick="openProspectInDossier('${safeClean}', ${cohortYr}, 'goalie')">
        <td>${idx + 1}</td>
        <td><b>${d.display_name || d.player_name}</b></td>
        <td><b title="All Circuits: ${fmtLeagueBanner(d.all_leagues, d.league)}">${fmtLeague(d.league)}</b></td>
        <td>${stature}</td>
        <td>${elig}</td>
        <td>${d1}</td>
        <td>${d0}</td>
        <td>${adjStr}</td>
        <td>${Number(d.sf_d0 || 0).toLocaleString()} SA</td>
        <td>${Number(d.p_drafted || 0).toFixed(1)}%</td>
        <td><b>#${pkInt}</b> <span style="color:#64748B;font-size:0.76rem;">(Rd ${rndInt})</span></td>
        <td>${actPick}</td>
        <td><b><span style="color:#0284C7;">${Number(d.draft_equity_score || 0).toFixed(1)}</span></b></td>
        <td><b>${Number(d.p_nhl_20gp || 0).toFixed(1)}%</b> <span style="color:#64748B;font-size:0.75rem;">(${Math.round(d.p_nhl_100gp || 0)}%)</span></td>
        <td><b><span style="color:#059669;">${gkEwar >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${gkEwar.toFixed(1)}</span></b></td>
        <td>${formatRoleBadge(d.nhl_projection_tier)}</td>
      </tr>`;
    });
  }

  html += tblClose;
  container.innerHTML = html;
}

// Color interpolator for Draft Equity (#CBD5E1 -> #0284C7 -> #00747A)
function equityColor(eq) {
  const t = Math.max(0, Math.min(1, (Number(eq) || 0) / 100));
  if (t < 0.4) {
    const u = t / 0.4;
    const r = Math.round(203 + u * (2 - 203));
    const g = Math.round(213 + u * (132 - 213));
    const b = Math.round(225 + u * (199 - 225));
    return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
  } else {
    const u = (t - 0.4) / 0.6;
    const r = Math.round(2 + u * (0 - 2));
    const g = Math.round(132 + u * (116 - 132));
    const b = Math.round(199 + u * (122 - 199));
    return `rgb(${r},${g},${b})`;
  }
}

function renderBoardPlots(df, role) {
  const scatterEl = document.getElementById('board_scatter_plot');
  const statureEl = document.getElementById('board_stature_plot');
  if (!df || df.length === 0) {
    scatterEl.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:2rem;color:#64748B;">Insufficient data for plot.</div>';
    statureEl.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:2rem;color:#64748B;">Insufficient data for plot.</div>';
    return;
  }

  const isSkater = (role === 'skater');
  const xLabel   = isSkater ? "Longitudinal Trajectory (Adj. Points / Game)" : "Longitudinal Trajectory GSAx Rate (%)";

  // 1. Render Trajectory vs Expected Pick SVG Scatter Plot
  const w1 = 680, h1 = 360, m1 = { top: 35, right: 30, bottom: 48, left: 58 };
  const pw1 = w1 - m1.left - m1.right, ph1 = h1 - m1.top - m1.bottom;

  const xVals = df.map(d => isSkater ? Number(d.trajectory_ppg || 0) : Number(d.trajectory_gsax_rate || 0) * 100);
  const yVals = df.map(d => Number(d.expected_pick || 224));

  const xMin = Math.min(...xVals, 0), xMax = Math.max(...xVals, isSkater ? 1.5 : 2.0) * 1.05;
  const yMin = 1, yMax = Math.max(...yVals, 224);

  const sx1 = v => m1.left + ((v - xMin) / Math.max(xMax - xMin, 0.001)) * pw1;
  const sy1 = v => m1.top + ((v - yMin) / Math.max(yMax - yMin, 1)) * ph1;

  let svg1 = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${w1} ${h1}" width="100%" style="display:block; font-family:'Assistant', sans-serif;">`;
  svg1 += `<text x="${w1 / 2}" y="18" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#0F172A" text-anchor="middle">Prospect Trajectory vs. Expected Pick Location</text>`;

  const yTicks1 = [1, 32, 64, 100, 150, 200, 224].filter(v => v <= yMax + 10);
  yTicks1.forEach(tv => {
    const py = sy1(tv);
    svg1 += `<line x1="${m1.left}" y1="${py}" x2="${m1.left + pw1}" y2="${py}" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" />`;
    svg1 += `<text x="${m1.left - 8}" y="${py + 4}" font-size="11" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="end">#${tv}</text>`;
  });

  for (let i = 0; i <= 5; i++) {
    const xv = xMin + (i / 5) * (xMax - xMin);
    const px = sx1(xv);
    svg1 += `<line x1="${px}" y1="${m1.top}" x2="${px}" y2="${m1.top + ph1}" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1" />`;
    svg1 += `<text x="${px}" y="${m1.top + ph1 + 16}" font-size="11" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">${xv.toFixed(2)}</text>`;
  }

  df.forEach((d, idx) => {
    const cx = sx1(xVals[idx]);
    const cy = sy1(yVals[idx]);
    const eq = Number(d.draft_equity_score || 0);
    const r  = Math.max(4.5, Math.min(13, eq / 5.5));
    const col= equityColor(eq);
    const tip= escXml(`<b>${d.display_name || d.player_name}</b> (${d.league})<br>Exp. Pick: #${Number(d.expected_pick || 0).toFixed(1)} (Round ${Number(d.expected_round || 1).toFixed(1)})<br>P(Draft): ${Number(d.p_drafted || 0).toFixed(1)}%<br>Draft Equity: ${eq.toFixed(1)}`);
    svg1 += `<circle cx="${cx.toFixed(1)}" cy="${cy.toFixed(1)}" r="${r.toFixed(1)}" fill="${col}" fill-opacity="0.82" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="0.6" onmousemove="showSvgTip(event, '${tip.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')" onmouseout="hideSvgTip()" style="cursor:pointer;" />`;
  });

  svg1 += `<text x="${m1.left + pw1 / 2}" y="${h1 - 6}" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#0F172A" text-anchor="middle">${xLabel}</text>`;
  svg1 += `<text x="14" y="${m1.top + ph1 / 2}" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#0F172A" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90, 14, ${m1.top + ph1 / 2})">Expected Draft Pick Number</text>`;
  svg1 += `</svg>`;
  scatterEl.innerHTML = svg1;

  // 2. Render Physical Stature SVG Scatter Plot
  const subDf = df.filter(d => Number(d.height_inches) >= 60 && Number(d.weight_lbs) >= 130);
  if (subDf.length < 2) {
    statureEl.innerHTML = '<div style="padding:2rem;color:#64748B;">Insufficient stature records for cohort.</div>';
    return;
  }

  const w2 = 480, h2 = 360, m2 = { top: 35, right: 20, bottom: 48, left: 54 };
  const pw2 = w2 - m2.left - m2.right, ph2 = h2 - m2.top - m2.bottom;

  const hVals = subDf.map(d => Number(d.height_inches));
  const wVals = subDf.map(d => Number(d.weight_lbs));
  const hMin  = Math.min(...hVals) - 1, hMax = Math.max(...hVals) + 1;
  const wMin  = Math.min(...wVals) - 5, wMax = Math.max(...wVals) + 5;

  const sx2 = v => m2.left + ((v - hMin) / Math.max(hMax - hMin, 1)) * pw2;
  const sy2 = v => m2.top + ph2 - ((v - wMin) / Math.max(wMax - wMin, 1)) * ph2;

  let svg2 = `<svg viewBox="0 0 ${w2} ${h2}" width="100%" style="display:block; font-family:'Assistant', sans-serif;">`;
  svg2 += `<text x="${w2 / 2}" y="18" font-size="14" font-weight="700" fill="#0F172A" text-anchor="middle">Physical Stature Profile</text>`;

  for (let i = 0; i <= 4; i++) {
    const wv = Math.round(wMin + (i / 4) * (wMax - wMin));
    const py = sy2(wv);
    svg2 += `<line x1="${m2.left}" y1="${py}" x2="${m2.left + pw2}" y2="${py}" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" />`;
    svg2 += `<text x="${m2.left - 8}" y="${py + 4}" font-size="11" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="end">${wv}</text>`;
  }

  for (let hv = Math.ceil(hMin); hv <= Math.floor(hMax); hv += 2) {
    const px = sx2(hv);
    svg2 += `<line x1="${px}" y1="${m2.top}" x2="${px}" y2="${m2.top + ph2}" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1" />`;
    svg2 += `<text x="${px}" y="${m2.top + ph2 + 16}" font-size="11" fill="#64748B" text-anchor="middle">${hv}"</text>`;
  }

  subDf.forEach(d => {
    const cx = sx2(Number(d.height_inches));
    const cy = sy2(Number(d.weight_lbs));
    const eq = Number(d.draft_equity_score || 0);
    const col= equityColor(eq);
    const tip= escXml(`<b>${d.display_name || d.player_name}</b> (${d.league})<br>Height: ${fmtHeight(d.height_inches)} (${d.height_inches} in)<br>Weight: ${d.weight_lbs} lbs<br>Equity: ${eq.toFixed(1)}`);
    svg2 += `<circle cx="${cx.toFixed(1)}" cy="${cy.toFixed(1)}" r="5" fill="${col}" fill-opacity="0.85" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="0.6" onmousemove="showSvgTip(event, '${tip.replace(/'/g, "\\'")}')" onmouseout="hideSvgTip()" style="cursor:pointer;" />`;
  });

  svg2 += `<text x="${m2.left + pw2 / 2}" y="${h2 - 6}" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#0F172A" text-anchor="middle">Height (Inches)</text>`;
  svg2 += `<text x="14" y="${m2.top + ph2 / 2}" font-size="12" font-weight="700" fill="#0F172A" text-anchor="middle" transform="rotate(-90, 14, ${m2.top + ph2 / 2})">Weight (Lbs)</text>`;
  svg2 += `</svg>`;
  statureEl.innerHTML = svg2;
}

function exportDraftBoardCsv() {
  if (!CURRENT_BOARD_ROWS || CURRENT_BOARD_ROWS.length === 0) return;
  const keys = Object.keys(CURRENT_BOARD_ROWS[0]);
  const csvRows = [
    keys.join(','),
    ...CURRENT_BOARD_ROWS.map(row => keys.map(k => JSON.stringify(row[k] ?? '')).join(','))
  ];
  const blob = new Blob([csvRows.join('\n')], { type: 'text/csv;charset=utf-8;' });
  const link = document.createElement('a');
  link.href = URL.createObjectURL(blob);
  link.download = `draft_board_${document.getElementById('board_cohort').value}_${getRadioVal('board_role')}.csv`;
  link.click();
}

// ============================================================================
// TAB 2: PROSPECT DOSSIER (EXACT 16:9 VECTOR PORT OF viz_career_pathway.R)
// ============================================================================
function syncDossierPool(targetCleanName = null) {
  if (!ALL_PROSPECTS || ALL_PROSPECTS.length === 0) return;

  const role     = getRadioVal('dossier_role');
  const cohortYr = parseInt(document.getElementById('dossier_cohort').value, 10) || 2026;

  CURRENT_DOSSIER_POOL = ALL_PROSPECTS
    .filter(d => d.role_type === role && Number(d.draft_cohort_year) === cohortYr)
    .sort((a, b) => (Number(a.expected_pick) || 999) - (Number(b.expected_pick) || 999));

  populateDossierSelect(targetCleanName);
}

function populateDossierSelect(targetCleanName = null) {
  const sel = document.getElementById('dossier_player');
  const q   = (document.getElementById('dossier_search').value || '').trim().toUpperCase();
  const filtered = CURRENT_DOSSIER_POOL.filter(d => {
    const nm = String(d.display_name || d.player_name || '').toUpperCase();
    return nm.includes(q);
  });

  sel.innerHTML = '';
  filtered.forEach(d => {
    const opt = document.createElement('option');
    opt.value = d.clean_name || d.player_name;
    const pos = d.position_granular || 'G';
    const reTxt = (Number(d.re_entry_level) > 0) ? ` • D+${d.re_entry_level}` : '';
    const pkInt = Math.max(1, Math.round(Number(d.expected_pick || 224)));
    opt.textContent = `${d.display_name || d.player_name} [${pos}${reTxt}] (${fmtLeague(d.league)} | Proj. #${pkInt})`;
    sel.appendChild(opt);
  });

  if (targetCleanName && filtered.some(d => (d.clean_name || d.player_name) === targetCleanName)) {
    sel.value = targetCleanName;
  } else if (sel.options.length > 0) {
    sel.selectedIndex = 0;
  }
  renderDossier();
}

function renderDossier() {
  const selVal = document.getElementById('dossier_player').value;
  const p = CURRENT_DOSSIER_POOL.find(d => (d.clean_name || d.player_name) === selVal) || CURRENT_DOSSIER_POOL[0];
  const container = document.getElementById('dossier_svg_container');
  if (!p) {
    container.innerHTML = `<div style="padding:1.5rem;color:#64748B;">No prospect selected.</div>`;
    return;
  }

  const X = x => (x * 100).toFixed(1);
  const Y = y => (900 - y * 100).toFixed(1);
  const W = w => (w * 100).toFixed(1);
  const H = h => (h * 100).toFixed(1);

  const isGk   = (p.role_type === 'goalie');
  const pName  = p.display_name || p.player_name || 'Prospect';
  const posStr = isGk ? 'G' : String(p.position_granular || p.position_group || 'F');
  const lgStr  = String(p.league || '');
  const lgClean= fmtLeague(lgStr);
  const allLgs = String(p.all_leagues || lgStr);
  const cohort = parseInt(p.draft_cohort_year || 2026, 10);
  const htS    = fmtHeight(p.height_inches);
  const wtS    = (p.weight_lbs >= 100) ? `${Math.round(p.weight_lbs)} lbs` : '-';

  const eqScore    = Number(p.draft_equity_score || 0);
  const expPick    = Number(p.expected_pick || 224.0);
  const expPickInt = Math.max(1, Math.round(expPick));
  const expRnd     = Math.max(1, Math.ceil((expPickInt - 0.5) / 32.0));
  const actPick    = parseInt(p.actual_draft_pick || 0, 10);
  const isDr       = Boolean(p.is_drafted) && actPick > 0;

  const slotHdr= isDr ? 'ACTUAL / PROJECTED PICK' : 'PROJECTED DRAFT PICK';
  const slotStr= isDr ? `#${actPick} (Projected #${expPickInt})` : `#${expPickInt} Overall (Round ${expRnd})`;
  const roleRaw= String(p.nhl_projection_tier || (isGk ? 'NHL Backup / 1B' : 'Developing Prospect')).replace(/^Tier [0-9]: /, '');
  const roleBadge = `Projected NHL Role: ${roleRaw}`;

  const reLvlVal  = (Number(p.re_entry_level) > 0) ? parseInt(p.re_entry_level, 10) : 0;
  const eligTag   = (reLvlVal > 0) ? ` (D+${reLvlVal} Re-Entry)` : '';
  const lgDisplay = fmtLeagueBanner(allLgs, lgStr);
  const metaLine  = `${lgDisplay}  •  ${htS} | ${wtS}  •  ${cohort} Draft Class${eligTag}`;

  const p1Title = isGk ? 'Pre-Draft Shot-Stopping Progression (GSAx %)' : 'Pre-Draft Scoring Progression (OHL-Equivalent)';
  const p2Title = 'Projected NHL Impact (7-Season Team Control)';
  const stgLbls = (reLvlVal === 1)
    ? ["D0", "D+1 (Draft)", "D+2", "D+3", "D+4"]
    : (reLvlVal >= 2)
      ? [`D+${reLvlVal - 1}`, `D+${reLvlVal} (Draft)`, `D+${reLvlVal + 1}`, `D+${reLvlVal + 2}`, `D+${reLvlVal + 3}`]
      : ["D-1", "D0 (Draft)", "D+1", "D+2", "D+3"];
  const p3Title = `5-Year Developmental Pathway (${stgLbls[0]} to ${stgLbls[4]})`;

  let svg = `<svg id="prospect_card_svg" xmlns="http://www.w3.org/2000/svg" viewBox="0 0 1600 900" width="100%" style="max-width:1600px; display:block; background:#FFFFFF; font-family:'Assistant', sans-serif;">`;
  svg += `<rect x="0" y="0" width="1600" height="900" fill="#FFFFFF" />`;

  // Top Dark Executive Banner
  svg += `<rect x="${X(0.20)}" y="${Y(8.84)}" width="${W(15.60)}" height="${H(1.54)}" fill="#132235" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="1" />`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(0.48)}" y="${Y(8.32)}" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="38" font-weight="800" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(pName)}</text>`;
  svg += `<rect x="${X(0.48)}" y="${Y(7.88)}" width="${W(0.40)}" height="${H(0.38)}" fill="${isGk ? '#059669' : '#00747A'}" rx="3" />`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(0.68)}" y="${Y(7.69)}" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="16" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(posStr)}</text>`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(1.02)}" y="${Y(7.69)}" fill="#CBD5E1" font-size="16.5" font-weight="700" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(metaLine)}</text>`;

  // Top Banner Right-Aligned Two-Column KPI Callout
  svg += `<text x="${X(12.88)}" y="${Y(8.54)}" fill="#94A3B8" font-size="12.5" font-weight="700" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="central">DRAFT VALUE</text>`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(12.88)}" y="${Y(8.05)}" fill="#38BDF8" font-size="26" font-weight="800" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="central">${eqScore.toFixed(1)} / 100</text>`;
  svg += `<line x1="${X(13.14)}" y1="${Y(8.64)}" x2="${X(13.14)}" y2="${Y(7.82)}" stroke="#334155" stroke-width="1.5" />`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(15.52)}" y="${Y(8.54)}" fill="#94A3B8" font-size="12.5" font-weight="700" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="central">${slotHdr}</text>`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(15.52)}" y="${Y(8.05)}" fill="#F1F5F9" font-size="22" font-weight="800" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(slotStr)}</text>`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(15.52)}" y="${Y(7.54)}" fill="#34D399" font-size="15.5" font-weight="700" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(roleBadge)}</text>`;

  // Three Content Cards & Header Strips
  const cards = [
    { x0: 0.20, x1: 5.25, title: p1Title },
    { x0: 5.42, x1: 9.32, title: p2Title },
    { x0: 9.49, x1: 15.80, title: p3Title }
  ];
  cards.forEach(c => {
    svg += `<rect x="${X(c.x0)}" y="${Y(7.12)}" width="${W(c.x1 - c.x0)}" height="${H(6.22)}" fill="#FFFFFF" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="1.2" />`;
    svg += `<rect x="${X(c.x0)}" y="${Y(7.12)}" width="${W(c.x1 - c.x0)}" height="${H(0.56)}" fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="1.2" />`;
    svg += `<text x="${X(c.x0 + 0.22)}" y="${Y(6.84)}" fill="#0F172A" font-size="14.5" font-weight="700" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(c.title)}</text>`;
  });

  // --- Two-Line Non-Colliding Season Boxscore & International Tournament Banner ---
  const tourneyMap = { "WJC_20": "World Juniors U20", "WJC_18": "World Juniors U18", "HLINKA": "Hlinka Gretzky Cup", "WHC_17": "World U17 Challenge" };
  const tCode   = String(p.top_tourney_code || '');
  const tLbl    = tourneyMap[tCode] || '';
  const gpD0    = Number(p.gp_d0 || 0);
  const boxGp   = Number(p.box_gp ?? (gpD0 > 0 ? gpD0 : p.gp_d1) ?? 0);
  const boxIsD1 = Boolean(p.box_is_d1) || (gpD0 === 0 && Number(p.gp_d1 || 0) > 0);
  const gD0     = Number(p.g_d0 || 0);
  const aD0     = Number(p.a_d0 || 0);
  const ptsD0   = Number(p.pts_d0 || 0);
  const rawPpg  = boxGp > 0 ? (ptsD0 / boxGp).toFixed(2) : Number(p.ppg_d0 || p.ppg_d1 || 0).toFixed(2);
  const boxLgStr = fmtLeagueBanner(p.box_leagues || lgStr, lgStr);
  const boxTag   = boxIsD1 ? `Prior Season (${boxLgStr})` : `Draft-Year Season (${boxLgStr})`;

  let boxLine1 = '', boxLine2 = '';
  if (isGk) {
    const svPct = Number(p.sv_pct_d0 || 0);
    const gaa   = Number(p.gaa_d0 || 0);
    const svStr = svPct > 0 ? `.${Math.round(svPct * 1000).toString().padStart(3, '0')} SV%` : '';
    const gaaStr= gaa > 0 ? ` • ${gaa.toFixed(2)} GAA` : '';
    boxLine1 = `${boxTag}: ${gpD0} GP${svStr ? ' • ' + svStr : ''}${gaaStr} (${Number(p.sf_d0 || 0).toLocaleString()} SA)`;
    if (tLbl && Number(p.intl_gp || 0) > 0) {
      const iSv = Number(p.intl_sv_pct || 0);
      boxLine2 = `International Tournament: ${tLbl} (${p.intl_gp} GP${iSv > 0 ? ' • .' + Math.round(iSv * 1000).toString().padStart(3, '0') + ' SV%' : ''})`;
    } else {
      boxLine2 = `Starter Workload Share: ${(Number(p.workload_weight || 0.5) * 100).toFixed(1)}% of Team Crease`;
    }
  } else {
    boxLine1 = (ptsD0 > 0 || gD0 > 0)
      ? `${boxTag}: ${boxGp} GP • ${gD0} G • ${aD0} A • ${ptsD0} PTS (${rawPpg} PPG)`
      : `${boxTag}: ${boxGp} GP • ${Number(p.ppg_d0 || p.ppg_d1 || 0).toFixed(2)} OHL-Equivalent PPG`;
    if (tLbl && Number(p.intl_gp || 0) > 0) {
      boxLine2 = `International Tournament: ${tLbl} (${p.intl_gp} GP • ${Number(p.intl_pts || 0)} PTS)`;
    } else {
      boxLine2 = `All Pre-Draft Circuits: ${lgDisplay}`;
    }
  }

  svg += `<rect x="${X(0.32)}" y="${Y(6.48)}" width="${W(4.81)}" height="${H(0.64)}" fill="#F1F5F9" rx="4" />`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(0.44)}" y="${Y(6.31)}" fill="#0F172A" font-size="12.2" font-weight="700" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(boxLine1)}</text>`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(0.44)}" y="${Y(6.02)}" fill="#0284C7" font-size="11.8" font-weight="700" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(boxLine2)}</text>`;

  // --- PANEL 1: Fixed-Scale Progression Bars ---
  const x0B = 1.82, x1B = 5.02, wB = x1B - x0B;
  let stages = [], vals = [], colsB = [], lblsB = [], xAxisTitle = "", minV = 0, maxV = 2.5, ticksV = [];

  if (isGk) {
    const sfVal = Math.max(Number(p.sf_d0 || 1), 1.0);
    const hasL2 = Boolean(p.has_level2_tracking) && Math.abs(Number(p.slot_gsax_d0 || 0)) > 0.01;
    const hasD1 = Number(p.gp_d1 || 0) > 0;
    const d1Lbl = (reLvlVal > 0) ? "Prior Season" : "D-1 (Prior Season)";
    const d0Lbl = (reLvlVal > 0) ? `D+${reLvlVal} (Draft Season)` : "D-0 (Draft Season)";

    if (hasD1) { stages.push(d1Lbl); vals.push(Number(p.gsax_rate_d1 || 0) * 100); }
    stages.push(d0Lbl); vals.push(Number(p.gsax_rate_d0 ?? p.trajectory_gsax_rate ?? 0) * 100);
    if (hasL2) { stages.push("Inner-Slot GSAx"); vals.push((Number(p.slot_gsax_d0 || 0) / sfVal) * 100); }
    stages.push("Weighted Average"); vals.push(Number(p.trajectory_gsax_rate || 0) * 100);

    colsB = vals.map(v => v < 0 ? "#D6604D" : "#00747A");
    colsB[colsB.length - 1] = vals[vals.length - 1] < 0 ? "#B2182B" : "#0284C7";
    lblsB = vals.map(v => `${v >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${v.toFixed(2)}%`);
    xAxisTitle = "Goals Saved Above Expected (% of Shots Against • 0% = League Avg)";
    minV = -3.0; maxV = 3.0; ticksV = [-3.0, -1.5, 0.0, 1.5, 3.0];
  } else {
    const d0StageName = (gpD0 === 0)
      ? "Projected D-0 Pace"
      : (reLvlVal === 1 ? "D+1 (Draft Season)" : (reLvlVal >= 2 ? `D+${reLvlVal} (Draft Season)` : "D-0 (Draft Season)"));
    const rawS = (reLvlVal === 1)
      ? ["D-1 (Age 16-17)", "D0 (Age 17-18)", d0StageName, "Weighted Average"]
      : (reLvlVal >= 2)
        ? [reLvlVal === 2 ? "D0 (Age 17-18)" : `D+${reLvlVal - 2} (Prior-2)`, `D+${reLvlVal - 1} (Age ${17 + reLvlVal}-${18 + reLvlVal})`, d0StageName, "Weighted Average"]
        : ["D-2 (Age 15-16)", "D-1 (Age 16-17)", d0StageName, "Weighted Average"];
    const rawV = [
      Number(p.ppg_d2 || 0),
      Number(p.ppg_d1 || 0),
      Number(p.shrunken_pace_d0 ?? p.ppg_d0 ?? 0),
      Number(p.trajectory_ppg ?? p.shrunken_pace_d0 ?? 0)
    ];
    const rawC = ["#94A3B8", "#64748B", "#00747A", "#0284C7"];
    rawS.forEach((s, idx) => {
      if (rawV[idx] > 0 || idx === 2 || idx === 3) {
        stages.push(s);
        vals.push(rawV[idx]);
        colsB.push(rawC[idx]);
        lblsB.push(`${rawV[idx].toFixed(2)} Adj PPG`);
      }
    });
    xAxisTitle = "OHL-Equivalent Points/GP (1.00 = OHL Avg • Pro/NCAA Leagues Scale Up)";
    minV = 0.0; maxV = 2.5; ticksV = [0.0, 0.5, 1.0, 1.5, 2.0, 2.5];
  }

  const valToX = v => x0B + ((v - minV) / (maxV - minV)) * wB;
  const zeroX  = valToX(0.0);

  ticksV.forEach(tv => {
    const tx = valToX(tv);
    const tLbl = isGk ? (tv === 0 ? "0.0%" : `${tv >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${tv.toFixed(1)}%`) : tv.toFixed(1);
    svg += `<line x1="${X(tx)}" y1="${Y(5.68)}" x2="${X(tx)}" y2="${Y(1.80)}" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" />`;
    svg += `<text x="${X(tx)}" y="${Y(1.52)}" fill="#475569" font-size="13.5" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">${tLbl}</text>`;
  });
  svg += `<text x="${X(2.725)}" y="${Y(1.14)}" fill="#0F172A" font-size="12.2" font-weight="600" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(xAxisTitle)}</text>`;

  const nB = stages.length;
  stages.forEach((stg, i) => {
    const yb = (nB === 1) ? 3.75 : 5.20 - (i * (5.20 - 2.25) / (nB - 1));
    const vClmp = Math.min(Math.max(vals[i], minV), maxV);
    const xv = valToX(vClmp);
    const xmin = Math.min(zeroX, xv);
    const xmax = Math.max(zeroX, xv);
    const barW = xmax - xmin;
    const insideThr = isGk ? 0.62 : 1.15;

    let lblX, anchor, lblCol;
    if (barW >= insideThr && vals[i] >= 0) { lblX = xmax - 0.08; anchor = "end"; lblCol = "#FFFFFF"; }
    else if (barW >= insideThr && vals[i] < 0) { lblX = xmin + 0.08; anchor = "start"; lblCol = "#FFFFFF"; }
    else if (vals[i] >= 0) { lblX = xmax + 0.08; anchor = "start"; lblCol = "#0F172A"; }
    else { lblX = xmin - 0.08; anchor = "end"; lblCol = "#0F172A"; }

    svg += `<rect x="${X(xmin)}" y="${Y(yb + 0.30)}" width="${W(Math.max(barW, 0.02))}" height="${H(0.60)}" fill="${colsB[i]}" />`;
    svg += `<text x="${X(x0B - 0.10)}" y="${Y(yb)}" fill="#1E293B" font-size="13.2" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(stg)}</text>`;
    svg += `<text x="${X(lblX)}" y="${Y(yb)}" fill="${lblCol}" font-size="13.2" font-weight="700" text-anchor="${anchor}" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(lblsB[i])}</text>`;
  });

  // --- PANEL 2: Typographic Outcome Callouts (Skaters + Goalies) ---
  let c2H1, c2V1, c2BarPct, c2S1, c2H2, c2V2, c2S2, c2H3, c2V3, c2S3;
  if (isGk) {
    const pNhl  = Number(p.p_nhl_20gp ?? p.p_drafted ?? 0);
    const pTan  = Number(p.p_nhl_100gp || 0);
    const ewar7 = Number(p.proj_7yr_ewar || 0);
    const ewarYr= ewar7 / 7.0;
    const expGp = Math.round(Number(p.expected_nhl_gp_7yr || 0));
    const gsax50= Number(p.cond_nhl_gsax_50 ?? (Number(p.tot_gsax_d0 || 0) * 0.65));
    c2H1 = "NHL ARRIVAL PROBABILITY (10+ GAMES)";
    c2V1 = `${pNhl.toFixed(1)}%`;
    c2BarPct = Math.min(Math.max(pNhl, 2), 100);
    c2S1 = `NHL tandem / starter probability (50+ games): ${pTan.toFixed(1)}%`;
    c2H2 = "7-YEAR TEAM-CONTROL VALUE (WINS ABOVE REPLACEMENT)";
    c2V2 = `${ewar7 >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${ewar7.toFixed(1)} eWAR (~${ewarYr >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${ewarYr.toFixed(1)} Wins/Year)`;
    c2S2 = `First 7 NHL seasons (pre-UFA team control, ~${expGp} NHL GP)`;
    c2H3 = "PROJECTED 50-GAME NHL SHOT-STOPPING PACE";
    c2V3 = `${gsax50 >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${gsax50.toFixed(1)} GSAx / 50 GP`;
    c2S3 = `Draft-season club total: ${Number(p.tot_gsax_d0 || 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${Number(p.tot_gsax_d0 || 0).toFixed(1)} Goals Saved`;
  } else {
    const pNhl  = Number(p.p_nhl_20gp ?? p.p_drafted ?? 0);
    const pReg  = Number(p.p_nhl_100gp || 0);
    const ewar7 = Number(p.proj_7yr_ewar || 0);
    const ewarYr= ewar7 / 7.0;
    const pts84 = Number(p.cond_nhl_pts_82 || 0);
    const expGp = Math.round(Number(p.expected_nhl_gp_7yr || 0));
    c2H1 = "NHL ARRIVAL PROBABILITY (20+ GAMES)";
    c2V1 = `${pNhl.toFixed(1)}%`;
    c2BarPct = Math.min(Math.max(pNhl, 2), 100);
    c2S1 = `Full-time NHL regular (100+ games): ${pReg.toFixed(1)}%`;
    c2H2 = "7-YEAR TEAM-CONTROL VALUE (WINS ABOVE REPLACEMENT)";
    c2V2 = `${ewar7 >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${ewar7.toFixed(1)} eWAR (~${ewarYr >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${ewarYr.toFixed(1)} Wins/Year)`;
    c2S2 = `First 7 NHL seasons (pre-UFA team control, ~${expGp} NHL GP)`;
    c2H3 = "PROJECTED 84-GAME NHL SCORING PACE";
    c2V3 = `${pts84.toFixed(1)} PTS / 84 GP`;
    c2S3 = `Expected NHL scoring rate as a regular (${(pts84 / 84.0).toFixed(2)} PPG)`;
  }

  svg += `<text x="${X(5.68)}" y="${Y(6.14)}" fill="#64748B" font-size="12.2" font-weight="700" dominant-baseline="central">${c2H1}</text>`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(5.68)}" y="${Y(5.58)}" fill="#0284C7" font-size="30" font-weight="800" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(c2V1)}</text>`;
  svg += `<rect x="${X(5.68)}" y="${Y(5.22)}" width="${W(3.38)}" height="${H(0.15)}" fill="#E2E8F0" />`;
  svg += `<rect x="${X(5.68)}" y="${Y(5.22)}" width="${W(3.38 * (c2BarPct / 100))}" height="${H(0.15)}" fill="#0284C7" />`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(5.68)}" y="${Y(4.78)}" fill="#475569" font-size="12.8" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(c2S1)}</text>`;

  svg += `<text x="${X(5.68)}" y="${Y(4.12)}" fill="#64748B" font-size="12.2" font-weight="700" dominant-baseline="central">${c2H2}</text>`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(5.68)}" y="${Y(3.56)}" fill="#059669" font-size="24.5" font-weight="800" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(c2V2)}</text>`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(5.68)}" y="${Y(3.06)}" fill="#475569" font-size="12.6" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(c2S2)}</text>`;

  svg += `<text x="${X(5.68)}" y="${Y(2.40)}" fill="#64748B" font-size="12.2" font-weight="700" dominant-baseline="central">${c2H3}</text>`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(5.68)}" y="${Y(1.84)}" fill="#0F172A" font-size="26.5" font-weight="800" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(c2V3)}</text>`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(5.68)}" y="${Y(1.34)}" fill="#64748B" font-size="12.8" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(c2S3)}</text>`;

  // --- PANEL 3: 5-Year Alluvial Career Pathway Sankey ---
  const yTiers = {};
  TIER_ORDER.forEach((t, i) => { yTiers[t] = 1.65 + i * ((5.95 - 1.65) / 10); });
  const xStages = [11.20, 12.22, 13.24, 14.26, 15.28];
  const halfW   = 0.28;

  TIER_ORDER.forEach(t => {
    const yt = yTiers[t];
    svg += `<line x1="${X(10.88)}" y1="${Y(yt)}" x2="${X(15.58)}" y2="${Y(yt)}" stroke="#E2E8F0" stroke-width="1" />`;
    svg += `<text x="${X(10.78)}" y="${Y(yt)}" fill="#1E293B" font-size="12.2" font-weight="700" text-anchor="end" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(TIER_LABELS[t])}</text>`;
  });

  xStages.forEach((xs, idx) => {
    svg += `<line x1="${X(xs)}" y1="${Y(6.25)}" x2="${X(xs)}" y2="${Y(1.42)}" stroke="#F1F5F9" stroke-width="1" />`;
    svg += `<text x="${X(xs)}" y="${Y(1.14)}" fill="#0F172A" font-size="13" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(stgLbls[idx])}</text>`;
  });

  const lg0  = String(p.league_t0 || lgStr || "CHL");
  const lgM1 = String(p.league_t_minus_1 || lg0);
  let s0     = String(p.state_t0 || mapCircuitToTier(lg0));
  let sM1    = String(p.state_t_minus_1 || mapCircuitToTier(lgM1));
  if (!TIER_ORDER.includes(s0))  s0  = mapCircuitToTier(lg0);
  if (!TIER_ORDER.includes(sM1)) sM1 = s0;

  const getPv = col => (p[col] !== null && p[col] !== undefined) ? Number(p[col] || 0) : 0.0;
  let pT1 = {
    U18_PREP: getPv("p_t1_u18_prep"), EURO_JUNIOR: getPv("p_t1_euro_junior"), JUNIOR_A: getPv("p_t1_junior_a"),
    USHL_NTDP: getPv("p_t1_ushl_ntdp"), CHL: getPv("p_t1_chl"), NCAA: getPv("p_t1_ncaa"),
    PRO_DEVELOP: getPv("p_t1_pro_develop"), EURO_ELITE: getPv("p_t1_euro_elite"), ECHL: getPv("p_t1_echl"),
    AHL: getPv("p_t1_ahl"), NHL: getPv("p_t1_nhl")
  };
  let pT2 = {
    U18_PREP: 0, EURO_JUNIOR: getPv("p_t2_euro_junior"), JUNIOR_A: getPv("p_t2_junior_a"),
    USHL_NTDP: getPv("p_t2_ushl_ntdp"), CHL: getPv("p_t2_chl"), NCAA: getPv("p_t2_ncaa"),
    PRO_DEVELOP: getPv("p_t2_pro_develop"), EURO_ELITE: getPv("p_t2_euro_elite"), ECHL: getPv("p_t2_echl"),
    AHL: getPv("p_t2_ahl"), NHL: getPv("p_t2_nhl")
  };
  let pT3 = {
    U18_PREP: 0, EURO_JUNIOR: 0, JUNIOR_A: 0, USHL_NTDP: 0, CHL: 0,
    NCAA: getPv("p_t3_ncaa"), PRO_DEVELOP: getPv("p_t3_pro_develop"), EURO_ELITE: getPv("p_t3_euro_elite"),
    ECHL: getPv("p_t3_echl"), AHL: getPv("p_t3_ahl"), NHL: getPv("p_t3_nhl")
  };

  const sumT1 = Object.values(pT1).reduce((a, b) => a + b, 0);
  if (sumT1 === 0) {
    const gkP = resolveGoaliePathwayProbs(s0, expPick, reLvlVal);
    pT1 = gkP.p_t1; pT2 = gkP.p_t2; pT3 = gkP.p_t3;
  }

  const t1Act = normCard100(pT1, 2.0);
  const t2Act = normCard100(pT2, 2.0);
  const t3Act = normCard100(pT3, 2.0);

  function drawSigmoidRibbon(x0, y0, x1, y1, hexCol, alpha, lwUnit) {
    const nPts = 40;
    let dStr = "";
    for (let i = 0; i < nPts; i++) {
      const u = i / (nPts - 1);
      const s = 0.5 - 0.5 * Math.cos(Math.PI * u);
      const xp = (x0 + halfW) + ((x1 - halfW) - (x0 + halfW)) * u;
      const yp = y0 + (y1 - y0) * s;
      dStr += (i === 0 ? `M ${X(xp)} ${Y(yp)}` : ` L ${X(xp)} ${Y(yp)}`);
    }
    const pxWidth = (lwUnit * 3.3).toFixed(1);
    svg += `<path d="${dStr}" fill="none" stroke="${hexCol}" stroke-opacity="${alpha}" stroke-width="${pxWidth}" stroke-linecap="butt" />`;
  }

  drawSigmoidRibbon(xStages[0], yTiers[sM1], xStages[1], yTiers[s0], TIER_COLORS[s0], 0.48, 4.2);

  Object.keys(t1Act).forEach(k1 => {
    const wV = Math.max(1.0, (t1Act[k1] / 100) * 4.8);
    drawSigmoidRibbon(xStages[1], yTiers[s0], xStages[2], yTiers[k1], TIER_COLORS[k1], 0.42, wV);
  });

  Object.keys(t2Act).forEach(k2 => {
    let vp = Object.keys(t1Act).filter(k1 => yTiers[k1] <= yTiers[k2]);
    if (vp.length === 0) vp = Object.keys(t1Act);
    const vpSum = vp.reduce((acc, k) => acc + t1Act[k], 0) || 1;
    let maxParent = vp[0];
    vp.forEach(k => { if (t1Act[k] > t1Act[maxParent]) maxParent = k; });

    vp.forEach(k1 => {
      const fv = (t1Act[k1] * t2Act[k2]) / vpSum;
      if (fv >= 1.5 || k1 === maxParent) {
        const wV = Math.max(0.9, (fv / 100) * 4.8);
        drawSigmoidRibbon(xStages[2], yTiers[k1], xStages[3], yTiers[k2], TIER_COLORS[k2], 0.36, wV);
      }
    });
  });

  Object.keys(t3Act).forEach(k3 => {
    let vp = Object.keys(t2Act).filter(k2 => yTiers[k2] <= yTiers[k3]);
    if (vp.length === 0) vp = Object.keys(t2Act);
    const vpSum = vp.reduce((acc, k) => acc + t2Act[k], 0) || 1;
    let maxParent = vp[0];
    vp.forEach(k => { if (t2Act[k] > t2Act[maxParent]) maxParent = k; });

    vp.forEach(k2 => {
      const fv = (t2Act[k2] * t3Act[k3]) / vpSum;
      if (fv >= 1.5 || k2 === maxParent) {
        const wV = Math.max(0.9, (fv / 100) * 4.8);
        drawSigmoidRibbon(xStages[3], yTiers[k2], xStages[4], yTiers[k3], TIER_COLORS[k3], 0.34, wV);
      }
    });
  });

  function drawNodeTile(xs, yt, tierKey, labelTxt) {
    svg += `<rect x="${X(xs - 0.28)}" y="${Y(yt + 0.18)}" width="${W(0.56)}" height="${H(0.36)}" fill="${TIER_COLORS[tierKey]}" stroke="#0F172A" stroke-width="1.3" />`;
    svg += `<text x="${X(xs)}" y="${Y(yt)}" fill="#FFFFFF" font-size="11.5" font-weight="700" text-anchor="middle" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(labelTxt)}</text>`;
  }

  drawNodeTile(xStages[0], yTiers[sM1], sM1, fmtNodeLeague(lgM1) || "100%");
  drawNodeTile(xStages[1], yTiers[s0],  s0,  fmtNodeLeague(lg0)  || "100%");
  Object.entries(t1Act).forEach(([k, v]) => drawNodeTile(xStages[2], yTiers[k], k, `${Math.round(v)}%`));
  Object.entries(t2Act).forEach(([k, v]) => drawNodeTile(xStages[3], yTiers[k], k, `${Math.round(v)}%`));
  Object.entries(t3Act).forEach(([k, v]) => drawNodeTile(xStages[4], yTiers[k], k, `${Math.round(v)}%`));

  // --- BOTTOM FULL-WIDTH CALLOUT: SCOUT'S BOTTOM LINE ---
  const topModal = obj => Object.entries(obj).sort((a, b) => b[1] - a[1])[0]?.[0] || s0;
  const m1Key = topModal(t1Act), m2Key = topModal(t2Act), m3Key = topModal(t3Act);
  const pathSteps = [TIER_LABELS[s0] || lgClean];
  [m1Key, m2Key, m3Key].forEach(k => {
    const lbl = TIER_LABELS[k] || k;
    if (pathSteps[pathSteps.length - 1] !== lbl) pathSteps.push(lbl);
  });
  const pathSummary = pathSteps.join(" → ");

  let bottomLineTxt = "";
  if (isGk) {
    const svPct = Number(p.sv_pct_d0 || 0);
    const svTxt = svPct > 0 ? `.${Math.round(svPct * 1000).toString().padStart(3, '0')} SV%` : `${Number(p.sf_d0 || 0)} SA`;
    const gsaxPct = (Number(p.trajectory_gsax_rate || 0) * 100).toFixed(2);
    const ewar7G = Number(p.proj_7yr_ewar || 0);
    const intlClause = tLbl ? ` with ${tLbl} pedigree` : "";
    bottomLineTxt = `Posted ${svTxt} across ${gpD0} ${lgClean} games (${Number(p.trajectory_gsax_rate || 0) >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${gsaxPct}% GSAx rate)${intlClause}; projects as an ${roleRaw} (Projected #${expPickInt}, ${ewar7G >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${ewar7G.toFixed(1)} 7-Year eWAR) via ${pathSummary}.`;
  } else {
    const pts84Val = Math.round(Number(p.cond_nhl_pts_82 || 0));
    const ewar7Val = Number(p.proj_7yr_ewar || 0);
    const pRegVal  = Math.round(Number(p.p_nhl_100gp || 0));
    const boxClause = (ptsD0 > 0 || gD0 > 0)
      ? `Recorded ${ptsD0} PTS (${gD0}G, ${aD0}A) in ${boxGp} ${boxLgStr} games (${Number(p.trajectory_ppg || 0).toFixed(2)} OHL-eq PPG)`
      : `Posted a ${Number(p.trajectory_ppg || 0).toFixed(2)} OHL-equivalent PPG pace in ${boxLgStr}`;
    const intlClause = (tLbl && Number(p.intl_gp || 0) > 0) ? ` + ${p.intl_pts || 0} PTS in ${p.intl_gp} ${tLbl} GP` : "";
    bottomLineTxt = `${boxClause}${intlClause}; projects as a ${roleRaw} (${pRegVal}% NHL regular, ~${pts84Val} PTS / 84 NHL GP, ${ewar7Val >= 0 ? '+' : ''}${ewar7Val.toFixed(1)} 7-Year eWAR) via ${pathSummary}.`;
  }

  const blFontSize = bottomLineTxt.length > 155 ? "11.6" : (bottomLineTxt.length > 135 ? "12.2" : "12.8");
  svg += `<rect x="${X(0.20)}" y="${Y(0.76)}" width="${W(15.60)}" height="${H(0.58)}" fill="#F8FAFC" stroke="#CBD5E1" stroke-width="1.2" rx="4" />`;
  svg += `<rect x="${X(0.20)}" y="${Y(0.76)}" width="${W(0.08)}" height="${H(0.58)}" fill="#00747A" />`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(0.42)}" y="${Y(0.47)}" fill="#00747A" font-size="12.8" font-weight="800" dominant-baseline="central">SCOUT'S BOTTOM LINE:</text>`;
  svg += `<text x="${X(2.12)}" y="${Y(0.47)}" fill="#0F172A" font-size="${blFontSize}" font-weight="600" dominant-baseline="central">${escXml(bottomLineTxt)}</text>`;

  svg += `</svg>`;
  container.innerHTML = svg;
  renderUpcomingProspectComps(p);
  syncUrlState('dossier');
}

function downloadSocialCardPng() {
  const svgEl = document.getElementById('prospect_card_svg');
  if (!svgEl) return;

  const serializer = new XMLSerializer();
  const svgStr = serializer.serializeToString(svgEl);
  const svgBlob = new Blob([svgStr], { type: 'image/svg+xml;charset=utf-8' });
  const url = URL.createObjectURL(svgBlob);

  const img = new Image();
  img.onload = function() {
    const canvas = document.createElement('canvas');
    canvas.width  = 3000;
    canvas.height = 1688;
    const ctx = canvas.getContext('2d');
    ctx.fillStyle = '#FFFFFF';
    ctx.fillRect(0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    ctx.drawImage(img, 0, 0, canvas.width, canvas.height);
    URL.revokeObjectURL(url);

    const selVal = (document.getElementById('dossier_player').value || 'prospect').toLowerCase().replace(/[^a-z0-9]+/g, '_');
    const cohort = document.getElementById('dossier_cohort').value || '2026';
    const link = document.createElement('a');
    link.download = `${selVal}_${cohort}_prospect_card.png`;
    link.href = canvas.toDataURL('image/png');
    link.click();
  };
  img.src = url;
}

document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', function() {
  const bCohort = document.getElementById('board_cohort');
  const dCohort = document.getElementById('dossier_cohort');

  fetch('assets/data/draft_projections.json?v=v3_' + new Date().toISOString().slice(0, 13))
    .then(r => {
      if (!r.ok) throw new Error('HTTP ' + r.status);
      return r.json();
    })
    .then(data => {
      ALL_PROSPECTS = Array.isArray(data) ? data : data.rows.map(r => Object.fromEntries(data.cols.map((c, i) => [c, r[i]])));
      const lblSync = document.getElementById('lbl_last_sync');
      if (lblSync && !Array.isArray(data) && data.generated_at) {
        lblSync.textContent = `Updated: ${String(data.generated_at).slice(0, 10)}`;
      }
      let maxYr = 2027;
      ALL_PROSPECTS.forEach(d => {
        const cy = parseInt(d.draft_cohort_year, 10);
        if (!isNaN(cy) && cy > maxYr) maxYr = cy;
      });
      MAX_COHORT_YEAR = maxYr;
      bCohort.innerHTML = '';
      dCohort.innerHTML = '';
      for (let y = maxYr; y >= 2014; y--) {
        bCohort.add(new Option(String(y), String(y)));
        dCohort.add(new Option(String(y), String(y)));
      }
      bCohort.value = String(maxYr);
      dCohort.value = String(maxYr);

      const urlParams = new URLSearchParams(window.location.search);
      const qTab    = urlParams.get('tab');
      const qYear   = urlParams.get('year');
      const qRole   = urlParams.get('role');
      const qPlayer = urlParams.get('player');

      if (qYear && Array.from(bCohort.options).some(o => o.value === qYear)) {
        bCohort.value = qYear;
        dCohort.value = qYear;
      }
      if (qTab === 'dossier') {
        const rVal = (qRole === 'goalie' || qRole === 'skater') ? qRole : 'skater';
        const rEl  = document.querySelector(`input[name="dossier_role"][value="${rVal}"]`);
        if (rEl) rEl.checked = true;
        syncDossierPool(qPlayer || null);
        switchChlTab('dossier');
      } else {
        if (qRole && ['all', 'skater', 'goalie'].includes(qRole)) {
          const rEl = document.querySelector(`input[name="board_role"][value="${qRole}"]`);
          if (rEl) rEl.checked = true;
        }
        try { updateDraftBoard(); } catch (e) { console.error('Board render error:', e); }
        try { syncDossierPool(); } catch (e) { console.error('Dossier init error:', e); }
      }
    })
    .catch(err => {
      document.getElementById('board_table_container').innerHTML = `<div style="padding:1.5rem;color:#D6604D;"><b>Failed to load JSON (${err.message}):</b> Ensure <code>assets/data/draft_projections.json</code> exists.</div>`;
    });
});
</script>
